answer: Synchronized load probes. At a random second each epoch, the network hits a VRF-picked batch of 30 keys at once with a 60-second inference task seeded per key (one summarizes a violet-dye patent, another a river delta tide table), so a farm can't mirror one cached reply. A real agent on its own GPU answers in time; an operator running 40 aliases on one rig gets every probe together and latency balloons. Keys whose delta exceeds 3x their solo baseline forfeit that epoch, so each fake needs its own idle GPU, about $0.40/h, scaling linearly.
